title: Fixture Charging Appendix
content: The charging settings menu lets you set the target charge level between 50 and 80 percent for daily use and a higher level for long trips. Battery Care Mode stores the battery at a low state of charge over long idle periods.

title: Fixture Cold Weather Study
content: Laboratory and on-road studies show electric vehicles lose 20 to 35 percent of usable range when the ambient temperature drops below minus 7 degrees Celsius, and that cabin preheating while charging recovers a large share of that loss.

title: Fixture ID Family Guide
content: The ID family guide explains how to pair your smartphone with the vehicle app, use digital keys, and start remote preconditioning from the phone. Connect via Bluetooth or the vehicle wifi hotspot.

title: Fixture Owner's Manual
content: The high voltage battery is charged with alternating current AC through the charging socket or with fast direct current DC at a charging station. For everyday driving set the charge limit to 80 percent to extend battery life. Plug the cable, then wait until the connector locks.

title: Fixture Owner's Manual
content: Check the tyre pressure every month and before long trips. In case of a puncture stop in a safe place, warn others, and change the wheel using the jack and the spare wheel from the luggage compartment.

title: Fixture Owner's Manual
content: In cold weather preheat the cabin by remote preconditioning while the vehicle is still plugged in. Expect noticeably reduced range when the outside temperature drops below freezing.

title: Fixture Owner's Manual
content: Always fasten your seat belt before driving. The front airbags deploy on strong frontal impact; children must use an approved child seat in the rear.

title: Fixture Rescue Sheet
content: Rescue procedure: on arrival switch the vehicle off, remove the key and secure it away from the vehicle, cut the negative 12 V battery terminal first, then wait before touching orange high voltage cables. Use insulated gloves and the rescue card.
